one_liner_zh: Zscaler營收年增逾25%且獲利超預期，零信任資安需求強勁，成長動能穩健。
one_liner_en: Zscaler beat on earnings with 25%+ revenue growth, underscoring robust zero-trust security demand and steady momentum.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 1.08美元優於預估1.01美元，意外幅度7.11%，營收年增25.43%。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正面：營收年增逾25%搭配獲利超預期，顯示零信任資安滲透率持續提升且營運槓桿釋放。短期股價有基本面支撐，惟資安股估值通常偏高，需指引維持強勁方能延續漲勢。中期關鍵在於計費收入（billings）、淨續約率與新產品（如AI資安、Data Protection）滲透。建議追蹤大型客戶數、剩餘履約義務（RPO）與自由現金流利潤率，確認成長品質。
ai_view_en: Positive signal: 25%+ revenue growth with an earnings beat shows rising zero-trust penetration and operating leverage. Fundamentals support the stock near-term, but security names carry rich valuations, so guidance must stay strong to sustain gains. Mid-term hinges on billings, net retention, and adoption of newer products (AI security, data protection). Track large-customer counts, RPO, and free-cash-flow margin to confirm growth quality.
highlights_zh: 營收8.505億美元，年增25.43%，訂閱動能強勁
EPS 1.08美元，優於預估1.01美元，意外幅度7.11%
零信任與SASE資安需求結構性成長
大型客戶ARR與淨續約率料維持健康水準
獲利與營收雙超預期，營運槓桿持續釋放
highlights_en: Revenue of $850.5M, up 25.43% YoY on strong subscription momentum
EPS of $1.08 beat the $1.01 estimate, a 7.11% surprise
Structural growth in zero-trust and SASE security demand
Large-customer ARR and net retention likely remain healthy
Both earnings and revenue beat, with continued operating leverage
risks_zh: 資安軟體競爭激烈，Palo Alto等對手擴張SASE市場
企業IT支出若放緩恐影響新增訂閱動能
本益比未提供，高成長股對營收指引敏感
risks_en: Intense security-software competition as Palo Alto and others expand SASE
A slowdown in enterprise IT spend could pressure new subscriptions
PE unavailable; high-growth stocks are sensitive to revenue guidance
